langs = [h, e]. Both languages ship inside ONE HTML file and the EN/ZH toggle switches visibility; no .e.html variant is written, because a second file per role would give one role two writers (check_form FM2) and two URLs for one page (A5). check_i18n.py therefore reports SKIP (its file-pair convention does not apply); the equivalent B6/B7 gates run inside i18n_overlay.py per language pair instead, and are strictly stronger because they compare arm-by-arm rather than page-by-page.

bin/onepage.py now writes deliverables/<slug>-onepage.html instead of docs/. docs/ is the gated six-page edition: check_form FM0 rejects any HTML there that STATE.pages[] does not claim, and a composed handout can never be claimed (FM1 rejects a role outside pageBudget, FM2 sees six roles with two writers each). A seventh file in docs/ made every build report qa-gate 6/7. The artefact is unchanged and was MOVED, not deleted (A5). Two defects were fixed at the same time: it opened with <title> so it carried no <meta charset> inside the 512-byte prescan window and shipped as mojibake (D1), and its chrome still referenced the retired --line token plus hard-coded hexes (C1). Its sticky nav also gained a solid --paper background: the redesigned .nav is transparent, so blur alone left body text bleeding through.
